evidence.title: BOSSAI used a human bridge between agents
evidence.observation: Acronis reports one operator bridging agents by manually copying outputs; agent-to-agent communication was not established. MM1’s inspected-source account records nine active agents out of twelve configured. The report describes compromises alongside refusals and operational failures.

terms.name: Constraint compression
terms.definition: A reduction, often AI-enabled, in the practical barriers of knowledge, expertise, labor, cost, time, or coordination that once limited an activity. It describes the change in constraints, not the eventual impact of the activity.

terms.name: System-level autonomy
terms.definition: A possible condition in which interactions among humans, organizations, and AI systems sustain consequential patterns no single participant meaningfully directs or can correct. It is a claim about collective operation, not necessarily autonomy of any one agent.

relationships.explanation: Commons interpretation: Human-mediated coordination does not establish collective operation beyond meaningful direction or correction.
Commons interpretation: The attributed single-operator campaign illustrates reduced practical barriers, bounded by refusals and failures.
